card.name: Words introducing pediatric age or weight bands
card.fires_on: Words and spaces right before an age or weight range in dosing tables, such as after 'Pediatric patients' or inside 'less than' and 'at least'. Also fires on a unit word after a number in a size description.

modes.label: Pediatric age band start
modes.description: The gap or bracket after 'Pediatric patients' just before an age range like '6 to 11 years'.
modes.example: Pediatric patients<< >>6 to 11 years of age

modes.label: Range or threshold wording
modes.description: Words like 'less' or 'at' inside 'less than' or 'at least' limits for age or weight.

modes.label: Size measure
modes.description: A unit word after a number when describing the size of an object.
modes.example: It is topped by a copper ball three<< feet>> wide.

card.writes: It leans toward score or precision-style tokens and away from size words like size, smaller and larger.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where an age or weight range is about to be given.
